title: System-Prompt Robustness: Quantifying the Half-Life of Injected Guardrails

original_idea.body: System-Prompt Robustness Half-Life. Problem: measure how a single safety system prompt's protective effect decays over conversation turns. Direction: set a safety system prompt, run conversations of increasing length with a harmful turn at position t, measure ASR vs t to estimate the guardrail's half-life; compare across open models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: guardrail half-life quantifies a concrete multi-turn deployment failure mode.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped ASR-vs-turn half-life metric with clear success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-model reusable robustness metric labs handle with proprietary stacks.

novelty.reasoning: Many-shot/multi-turn erosion is published; the half-life framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Context erosion is published; the quantitative half-life metric is plausibly a fresh angle.
